description: This file defines the Coocook::Model::Ingredients class, which contains business logic for handling data structures related to Dish and Recipe ingredients, including methods for converting ingredients to array references and preparing data for editing.

classes.name: Coocook::Model::Ingredients
classes.description: A class encapsulating business logic for handling ingredient data structures, including methods for converting ingredients to array references and preparing data for editing.

methods.name: build_project
methods.description: Builds and returns the associated project object based on the ingredients.

methods.name: as_arrayref
methods.description: Converts the ingredients into an array reference of hash structures, including associated articles and units, scaled by the factor.

methods.name: for_ingredients_editor
methods.description: Prepares ingredient data for editing, including converting units into plain hashes and listing convertible units.
